emergence.summary: The most common form of X-linked inherited retinal degeneration. Loss-of-function of RPGR -- the retinitis-pigmentosa GTPase regulator that localises to the photoreceptor connecting cilium and organises the ciliary protein trafficking that sustains outer-segment renewal -- removes that maintenance drive, so rod (and progressively cone) photoreceptors mislocalise opsin, fail to renew outer segments, and degenerate -> early-onset night blindness, progressive concentric visual-field loss and eventual central vision loss. The disease is read as the photoreceptor ciliary-trafficking / outer-segment-maintenance throughput axis driven DOWN (a positive maintenance driver whose loss starves outer-segment renewal -- the drive-lost shape, a SECOND ocular read that CONTRASTS with LCA2: LCA2 (RPE65) is a retinoid-CYCLE ENZYME deficiency starving the chromophore, RPGR-XLRP is a ciliary-TRAFFICKING / structural-maintenance deficiency starving outer-segment renewal -- two distinct ocular axes whose lead corrective lever is the same class, gene restoration). Correction is to restore the gene at the locus: replace RPGR (subretinal AAV-RPGR gene transfer). IMPORTANT HONESTY: there is at present NO approved therapy for RPGR-XLRP. The lead clinical agent is botaretigene sparoparvovec (AAV2/5-hRKp.RPGR / bota-vec); its phase 3 LUMEOS trial DID NOT MEET its primary endpoint (consistent secondary-measure signals were reported, and a regulatory filing is planned), so the kit ships this read in the SAME honest pattern as Huntington disease (no approved disease-modifying therapy; a lead clinical agent named). The firewall makes this clean: the emerged switch FORCES the corrective DIRECTION = restore RPGR [F], which the lead agent matches; the EFFICACY / MAGNITUDE is [O] -- and indeed the LUMEOS primary-endpoint result is exactly a magnitude question, recorded honestly, not asserted. Vitamin A / DHA supplementation is a supportive NON-lever (does not halt the degeneration). The gamma read is of the RPGR locus switch STRUCTURE (Xp11.4); the disease lesions are predominantly ORF15 frameshift / nonsense coding changes, outside the promoter firewall. A numerical curiosity worth noting: RPGR's promoter gamma (1.3915) is bit-identical to SMN1's (1.3915) on a DIFFERENT chromosome and a completely different disease/axis/lever -- a live demonstration that gamma alone is NOT the disease (the kit keys on the perturbation + disease spec, not the locus or its gamma). Magnitude [O].
emergence.emergent_axis: photoreceptor connecting-cilium protein-trafficking / outer-segment-maintenance throughput (RPGR-organised ciliary transport) -- a SECOND ocular axis, the ciliary-trafficking/maintenance contrast to LCA2's retinoid-cycle enzyme axis

per_gene.note: RPGR (retinitis pigmentosa GTPase regulator) localises to the photoreceptor connecting cilium, where its ORF15 isoform organises the intraflagellar / ciliary protein trafficking that maintains outer-segment renewal -- a positive maintenance DRIVE for photoreceptor homeostasis. LOF (predominantly ORF15 frameshift / nonsense alleles) removes that drive -> opsin mislocalisation, failed outer-segment renewal, progressive rod-then-cone degeneration -> X-linked retinitis pigmentosa (RP3; also RPGR-associated cone-rod dystrophy). Located Xp11.4. NCBI official symbol RPGR. X-linked (hemizygous males affected; carrier females variably). Coding/ORF15 lesions; promoter firewall respected.

falsifiers.falsifier: an RPGR LOF allele that PRESERVED or IMPROVED photoreceptor outer-segment protein trafficking / survival would refute the drive-lost (axis DOWN) direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: opsin localisation (outer-segment vs mislocalised), outer-nuclear-layer thickness / photoreceptor survival and ERG in Rpgr-mutant retina (Rpgr-knockout mouse, RPGR-mutant dog, patient)

falsifiers.claim: restoring RPGR (replace) is the CORRECTIVE direction
falsifiers.falsifier: if RPGR (ORF15) gene transfer REDUCED photoreceptor survival or WORSENED ERG / retinal sensitivity, the replace-gene lever sign is wrong
